def decodeVarintAuxL275–289 ↗#

LEB128 varint decoder (prost::encoding::varint::decode_varint_slow): 1 to 10 bytes, with the 10th byte required to be < 0x02.

def decodeVarintAux : Nat → Nat → BitVec 64 → Bytes → Except DecodeErr (BitVec 64 × Bytes) | 0, _, _, _ => .error .invalidVarint | fuel + 1, idx, acc, bs => match bs with | [] => .error .bufferUnderflow | b :: rest => if idx == 9 then if b ≥ 0x02#8 then .error .invalidVarint else .ok (acc ||| ((b &&& 0x7f#8).zeroExtend 64 <<< 63), rest) else let acc' := acc ||| ((b &&& 0x7f#8).zeroExtend 64 <<< (idx * 7)) if b < 0x80#8 then .ok (acc', rest) else decodeVarintAux fuel (idx + 1) acc' rest

def decodeVarint (bs : Bytes) : Except DecodeErr (BitVec 64 × Bytes) := decodeVarintAux 10 0 0#64 bs

def decodeKeyL303–312 ↗#

prost::encoding::decode_key: validates key ≤ u32::MAX, 3-bit WireType, and tag ≥ 1.

def decodeKey (bs : Bytes) : Except DecodeErr ((BitVec 32 × WireType) × Bytes) := do let (key, rest) ← decodeVarint bs if key > 0xffffffff#64 then .error (.invalidKey key) else let wt ← match WireType.ofU64? (key &&& 0x7#64) with | some w => .ok w | none => .error (.invalidWireType (key &&& 0x7#64)) let tag : BitVec 32 := (key >>> 3).truncate 32 if tag < MIN_TAG then .error (.invalidTag tag) else .ok ((tag, wt), rest)

def mergeMessage {M : Type} (mergeField : M → BitVec 32 → WireType → Bytes → Nat → Except DecodeErr (M × Bytes)) (wt : WireType) (m : M) (bs : Bytes) (depth : Nat) : Except DecodeErr (M × Bytes) := do checkWireType .lengthDelimited wt match depth with | 0 => .error .recursionLimitExceeded | depth' + 1 => do let (len, rest) ← decodeVarint bs let (sub, after) ← takeExact len.toNat rest let m' ← mergeFieldsLoop mergeField sub.length m sub depth' .ok (m', after)
